comment: vue-tsc typecheck of the app's Vue JSX (.tsx). @symbiote-native/* resolve to source (the monorepo's by-design source resolution), so this also re-checks adapter/engine source — `types: [node]` restores the runtime globals (setTimeout/process/console/queueMicrotask) the app tsconfig strips with `types: []`. That is the ONLY thing this file adds: the JSX factory and the e2e exclusion live in tsconfig.json, so an editor sees them too.
